title: The 5 Most Subscribed YouTube Channels, Ranked (#1 Beats the US Population)

scenes.text: The five most subscribed channels on YouTube. Number one has more subscribers than the United States has people.

scenes.label: Vlad and Niki · 151M
scenes.text: Number five: Vlad and Niki. 151 million subscribers for a kids' channel built around two brothers.

scenes.label: SET India · 190M
scenes.text: Number four: SET India. 190 million, the YouTube channel of an Indian television network.

scenes.label: Cocomelon · 203M
scenes.text: Number three: Cocomelon. 203 million subscribers, almost all of it nursery rhymes.

scenes.label: T-Series · 316M
scenes.text: Number two: T-Series. 316 million. An Indian music label that held the top spot for about five years.

scenes.label: MrBeast · 526M
scenes.text: Number one: MrBeast. 526 million subscribers as of November 2026. More than the entire population of the United States.

description:
The five most subscribed YouTube channels, ranked by subscribers according to vidIQ's chart for 9 November 2026: MrBeast (526 million), T-Series (316 million), Cocomelon (203 million), SET India (190 million) and Vlad and Niki (151 million).
MrBeast passed T-Series for the top spot in 2024; T-Series had held it for about five years.
Which channel do you think will be number one in five years?
subject: youtube play button
first_comment: MrBeast at 526 million. Who takes number one in five years, and what should we rank next?
